description.narrative: The Africa-driven Modelling Capacity and Communication (ADMeCC) project was a collaborative effort between the Energy Systems Research Group (ESRG) at the University of Cape Town (UCT) and the UK-based Climate Compatible Growth (CCG) Programme. The project aimed to significantly enhance policy-focused energy and emissions modelling capacity within South Africa and across the African continent. The project's overarching goal was to bolster the evidence base for critical energy and climate policy decisions, particularly within South Africa's dynamic policy landscape. This involved strengthening the ESRG's analytical capabilities, developing relevant policy briefs in consultation with key decision-makers like the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE), providing peer-reviewed documentation, and fostering engagement within national and international climate policy spheres. The project recognized the paramount importance of robust energy/emissions/economy systems modelling in informing policies related to the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP), Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), Sectoral Emissions Targets (SETs), carbon budgets, long-term low-emissions development, and the economic impacts of carbon taxation.
Payments were made on a quarterly basis (between Aug 2023 to March 2025)
